steps.content: The crazed monsters are shattered, and as you contain the horrific phantoms, Enfer crushes them.
The statues' grotesque colors fade, and their twisted shells slowly dissolve layer by layer, revealing broken plasters inside. They quietly pile up at her feet.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: They're not moving anymore? We got them, right?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Relax. It's over. This is what they initially looked like before Witching Hour twisted them.

options: Do you hate it when your work is distorted?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Those thrill-seeking Eastsiders misinterpret your works, which you don't want, so you want to destroy them yourself?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I don't have anything against the audience. To be misunderstood is the fate of expressers, and only the best artists can fully analyze and completely express themselves.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: A true masterpiece would never be mutated even during this Witching Hour, for it can pierce everyone's perception and manifest itself. Nobody will misinterpret it.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: And obviously, I'm not there yet.

options: Is Sosia a successful masterpiece of yours?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: She is loved but not distorted. You wanted to convey something through her, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Are you willing to destroy her?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Sir, are you worried about me or doubting me?
steps.female_content: Ma'am, are you worried about me or doubting me?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hehe, it's all right. Let me tell you everything about her as we go. The path is long enough for a little story.
She steps over the debris and walks down the spiral staircase.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Enfer's birth was once the talk of the art world. Her mother was a budding oil painter, and her father a famous sculptor. Their marriage was seen as the union of love and art, giving her a wonderful, happy childhood.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: But perhaps artists all have a tendency for brokenness. Enfer's mother disappeared, leaving behind a wrecked studio, nasty gossip, a young daughter, and a mentally disturbed husband. She was never found.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Since then, her father spent all his days in the workshop, obsessed with his sculptures. He soon created <color=#fb9259>The Truthful One</color>, which was a huge success and opened up a new genre of thriller art.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: "What a great artist! He lost his lover, was trapped in pain, and plunged into madness, but in doing so, he transcended himself and realized his lifelong artistic pursuit!"

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: No one made fun of his marriage or madness ever again. More than a decade passed, and he remained an acknowledged master—until he disappeared in his workshop, just like his wife back then, leaving behind only a trail of appalling misery.
EMP almost screams out, but Hella covers her mouth in time.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Three days later, Enfer created <color=#fb9259>The False One</color>, following her father's footsteps. She became even more popular, actually outpacing many competitors to host this year's Witching Hour all by herself.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Like that, the family's appalling tragic story was quickly forgotten. The daughter inherited the blessings and curses of the crazy art family and stepped into the spotlight with all the scary rumors surrounding her.

options: It only took you three days to complete "The False One"?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I don't know sculpture or "stories," but I know it's impossible to finish a masterpiece sculpture in three days.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Enfer, what really happened the night your father disappeared?

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You see stories from a very special angle indeed. Yes, that was a special night, and I was the first to arrive at the scene.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Apart from The Truthful One, all sculptures were destroyed, the floor was painted with unrecognizable letters, the walls had huge cracks, and almost everything was broken by strange forces... That was no power of ordinary humans.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: And through the open window, I saw a huge crimson halo rising from the west bank of the Rust. At that moment, my soul was completely seized...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: When I returned to my senses, The False One was already finished. It stood in the broken workshop, looking down at me, opposite "The Truthful One."
Enfer doesn't answer for a long time, as if she hasn't heard your question or is reminiscing about the abyss. After a while, she finally turns to respond, and her calm smile returns.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Father disappeared 2 months ago, <color=#fb9259>August 20th</color>.
...It's the day of BR-004.
Every time a Black Ring appears, the number of mental cases in the city skyrockets.

You don't have to be in contact with contamination to get mentally ill. You might get mentally ill simply by observing a Black Ring, discussing it, or even imagining it. We can't manage the influence of a Black Ring when it's out in the open.

You haven't forgotten what he said, but for the first time, you're starting to understand its meaning. The impact of Black Ring is insidious and far-reaching. In the face of disaster, everyone is equally insignificant, like the famous artist in front of you.
No amount of fame and status will help, and once her identity as a Sinner is made public, she will lose everything.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Don't look sad. Doesn't the story suit me? Artists are always accompanied by madness, and Eastside loves stories like this, not to mention that night answered so many questions I dwelled on for years.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I saw darkness beyond the glory, the unfathomable unknown, countless people hissing, growling and struggling in the chaos and distortion. It tore my soul apart, uncovering everything in disguise. At that moment, I finally witnessed the reality of this world...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Fame and prosperity are ridiculous, love and happiness can be false, only fear cannot be concealed. The world is already distorted and cruel. I can't use the so-called beauty and compassion to create false peace, but at least I can carve out the reality I see.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: To awaken all forms of fear with my works, and reach the truth and people's hearts, this is my dream as an artist... But unfortunately, I'm not really there yet.
She looks over at Lisa.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: You know, the art world offers only vain fame. I'm not a great creator, and I fail all the time. My every creation is accompanied by pain, and even with the Sinner's power, I can't clearly portray the fear in my heart.
Lisa opens her mouth as if she wants to argue but then grits her teeth to listen.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Luckily, there's Sosia... She is the closest I've ever come to achieving my goal, and I have a feeling that she can make my dream come true. If even she is twisted by Witching Hour...

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: I will destroy her myself. My incompetence brought this misfortune to them, and it's up to me to bring them peace.
Enfer's smile fades. Like when you first met, she leans against the Gate of Hell, her eyes downcast, looking sorrowful.
Now you understand that she wanted to enter the section to end Witching Hour then. But she was hesitating to break Gate of Hell, her own work.

options: I only want you to help me end Witching Hour.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As for how you do it, I don't care. Sosia is still her true self now. If I were you, I'd rush to her side and find a way to free her from the mutation—while there's still a chance.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If you can find a way, I will help you, just as you helped me.

steps.speaker: Enfer
steps.content: Hehe, makes sense. You really are something else. I'd love to hear how you feel when you meet Sosia.

options: Come on. Let's go see Sosia.

steps.content: You step toward the destination, where Sosia is waiting for you.
...She suddenly looks up. The veil covers her face, but... there's no doubt she's looking at you.
...No, not you, she's looking at...
Enfer's body suddenly begins to turn into plaster. From her limbs to her heart, Enfer's horrified expression solidified, and even her hair turns white.
Damn it!
You release the shackles, but the spikes pierce into the fragile plaster, and the pure white "Enfer" instantly shatters. The broken pieces fall to the ground and are quickly dissolved.
